description: This source file implements submodule configuration management within a Git repository, including cache management, parsing of .gitmodules files, submodule lookup, and configuration updates.

classes.name: submodule_cache
classes.description: Cache structure for submodule configurations, holding hashmaps for path and name lookups and status flags.

classes.name: submodule_entry
classes.description: Wrapper for submodule configuration entries used within hashmaps.

classes.name: fetch_config
classes.description: Holds fetch-related configuration parameters for submodule operations.
